description: Simulates a restriction digest with a CALLER-SUPPLIED enzyme definition and yields the resulting fragments, each with its sequence, start, length, flanking enzymes and the blunt/5'/3' overhang of each cut end. The enzyme is given exactly as in find_sites_custom_enzyme (recognition sequence plus the two cut offsets, optionally a second pair for a two-sided Type IIB cutter). Fragment conventions, the circular k-fragments-for-k-cuts rule and the methylation mode are exactly as in restriction_digest. Call when the enzyme is not one of the 754 named REBASE enzymes — for a named one use restriction_digest.

sequence.description: DNA sequence to digest. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence.

recognition_sequence.description: Recognition sequence of the custom enzyme: 1 or more of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes; need not be palindromic. At most 64 bases (REBASE's longest is 15).

cut_position_forward.description: Top-strand cut offset: the number of recognition-sequence bases 5' of the cut. May be negative or exceed the site length for a distal cutter.

cut_position_reverse.description: Bottom-strand cut offset in the same frame. The two cuts may be at most 64 bases apart (the stagger, i.e. the overhang length); a larger one is refused.

name.description: Name reported on each fragment's flanking-enzyme fields; defaults to "CustomEnzyme". At most 64 characters.

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

second_cut_forward.description: Optional second top-strand cut offset of a two-sided (Type IIB) cutter; pass both second offsets or neither.

second_cut_reverse.description: Optional second bottom-strand cut offset; must leave the same stagger as the first pair.

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam", "dcm", "dam+dcm" or "emboss".

fragments.description: Fragments in the same shape as restriction_digest.

leftEnzyme.description: First name of leftEnzymes (ordinal order), or null when the left end is not a cut.

rightEnzyme.description: First name of rightEnzymes (ordinal order), or null when the right end is not a cut.

leftOverhangType.description: End chemistry of the left end, or null when that end was not created by a cut.

leftOverhang.description: Left end's single-stranded extension, 5'-3' on the strand carrying it; empty for a blunt end, null for an uncut end.

rightOverhangType.description: End chemistry of the right end, or null when that end was not created by a cut.

rightOverhang.description: Right end's single-stranded extension, 5'-3' on the strand carrying it; empty for a blunt end, null for an uncut end.

leftEnzymes.description: Every enzyme whose top-strand cut made the left end (isoschizomers / nested sites cutting at the same position), once each, ordinal order of the table names; empty for an uncut end.

rightEnzymes.description: Every enzyme whose top-strand cut made the right end, as leftEnzymes.

errors.message: Pass both second_cut_forward and second_cut_reverse, or neither.
Enzyme '<name>' recognition sequence '<site>' contains '<char>' at index <i>, which is not one of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes
Enzyme '<name>' second cut pair (<f>, <r>) leaves a different stagger from its first pair
Sequence cannot be null or empty.
Unknown methylation set '{name}'; expected none, dam, dcm, dam+dcm or emboss.
The topology must be MoleculeTopology.Linear or MoleculeTopology.Circular.
Enzyme '<name>' cuts its two strands <n> bases apart (<f>, <r>); the largest supported stagger is 64.
Enzyme '<name>' has a recognition sequence of <n> bases; the longest supported is 64.
The enzyme name is <n> characters long; the longest supported name is 64.
